description: Appodeal ad mediation SDK. The public facade lives in com.appodeal.ads; the ad-rendering runtime (IAB MRAID/VAST, Open Measurement) and a shaded protobuf are shipped under com.explorestack (Exodus signature: com.explorestack).

methods.name: initialize
methods.note: Main SDK init (all 4 overloads return void). HANG RISK: the overload initialize(Activity,String,int,ApdInitializationCallback) never invokes onInitializationFinished when stubbed — apps that gate startup on init completion may hang. Prefer relying on the ad_operations stubs (show=false / isLoaded=false) and testing before shipping.

methods.name: show
methods.note: boolean show(Activity,int[,String]) — report that no ad was shown

methods.name: cache
methods.note: void cache(Activity,int[,int]) — do not fetch ads. HANG RISK: per-ad load callbacks (onXxxLoaded / onXxxFailedToLoad) never fire; apps that wait for a load result before proceeding may stall.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.note: boolean isLoaded(int) — always report no ad available

methods.name: canShow
methods.note: boolean canShow(int[,String]) — always report cannot show

manifest_components.note: Fullscreen video ad player (core AAR manifest)

explorestack IAB VAST video ad activity (referenced in real smali)

protected_patterns.reason: Returns a com.appodeal.ads.rewarded.Reward object — stubbing to null would NPE the app's reward-handling code.
Returns an android.util.Pair — stubbing to null would NPE callers that read the reward amount/currency.
Returns an Activity reference — null causes NPE.
Ad callback interfaces (Interstitial/RewardedVideo/Banner/Mrec/Native/Request/AdRevenue). These are the SDK->app bridge; never stub their delivery methods or the app's own listeners break.
Callback registration setters — leave intact so the app's listeners stay wired to the (already-neutralized) SDK; stubbing them adds no safety and only risks NPEs on the returned/registered objects.
Initialization callback interface — onInitializationFinished must remain callable; do not stub it. See HANG RISK note on Appodeal.initialize.
